quarterly_data.signal: ACM Shanghai's record of its May 14, 2026 earnings call (Exhibit 99.1): newly signed orders in the first quarter of 2026 grew 65% year over year, and 2026 revenue guidance was kept unchanged. The average delivery cycle is approximately six months, so some first-quarter orders will be delivered this year and others carried into the first quarter of next year; order backlog is disclosed at the end of September each year.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 newly signed orders +65% YoY; average delivery cycle approximately six months

quarterly_data.signal: ACM's high-temperature single-wafer SPM cleaning solution achieves particle control down to 15 particles at the 15 nm level, with a plan to further reduce particle size to 13nm; its nozzle design avoids the periodic DI water cleaning of chambers that mainstream solutions require, and the tool has attracted interest from both domestic and overseas customers.
quarterly_data.figure: 15 particles at the 15 nm level (plan to reduce to 13nm)
